title: CPI-U, all items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted

footnotes.text: Data unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations

annualExceptionReference.method: BLS specifies the mean of the eleven published indexes for affected series in 2025; missing October remains unavailable as a monthly observation.

integrationGuidance: Monthly historical adjustment = amount * CPI_to / CPI_from; cumulative inflation percent = (CPI_to/CPI_from - 1)*100.
Select only numeric published months. A requested 2025-10 endpoint must return an unavailable-data explanation, not a carried-forward or interpolated value.
An interval crossing 2025-10 can still compare two available endpoints; only endpoint values are required for cumulative change.
Reject future/unpublished endpoints, including 2026-09 as of verification. Do not manufacture current-month CPI from a flat inflation assumption.
Keep user-assumed future inflation in a separate scenario mode.
Monthly and annual-average modes are distinct. Do not label an average of available current-year months as a full-year annual CPI.
The 2025 annual average is an official eleven-month exception, confirmed separately as 321.943.
Sources are NSA CPI-U, not seasonally-adjusted CUSR0000SA0, CPI-W, or chained C-CPI-U.
Version the data with verifiedOn and dataThrough visible in the method details; refresh after official release and check for BLS corrections.
